name: What should a homeowner do to prepare for cabin maintenance service?

mainEntity.name: What should a homeowner do to prepare for cabin maintenance service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before work begins, clear the perimeter around the cabin by trimming back shrubs, trees, and tall grasses at least three feet from the walls. Move outdoor patio furniture, firewood piles, and decorations away from exterior walls, and ensure water and electrical hookups are accessible for equipment. If interior finish repairs, drywall patching, or remodeling work are included in the project, clear items from adjacent interior walls and window sills to give the work crew clean access.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim vegetation at least three feet from walls, move outdoor furniture and firewood away from the structure, and clear interior walls near work areas.
